name: LGBT Center of Raleigh – Community Closet & Pantry
evidence: LGBTQ+ community center offering Trans & Gender Expansive and Queer Life programs, Transgender Discussion Group, LGBTQ+ Health Fair.

name: Planned Parenthood – Raleigh Health Center
evidence: "This health center supports and welcomes all people regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or biological sex"; offers gender-affirming care.

name: Healing Transitions
evidence: Runs "Healing Transitions' LGBTQ+ recovery meeting, The Rainbow Warriors" - weekly meeting begun as a dedicated space for LGBTQ+ participants.

name: NC Harm Reduction Coalition – Raleigh
evidence: Hosts peer support groups for trans and gender-nonconforming people; states "all harm reduction services should be trans-inclusive."

name: El Centro Hispano – Raleigh Office
evidence: Advocacy department works to "uphold the rights, dignity, and safety of Hispanic/Latino, immigrant, and LGBTQ communities"; hosts annual Orgullo/Pride event.

name: Legal Aid of North Carolina – Raleigh Office
evidence: Shall not discriminate "in the provision of any of its services to clients" based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, among others.

name: North Carolina Justice Center, Raleigh
evidence: "We stand in solidarity with the LGBTQIA+ community"; mission seeks fair treatment regardless of gender identity or sexual orientation.

name: Simple Gifts Community Garden
evidence: Statement of Inclusion responding to UMC exclusion of LGBTQIA persons: all welcomed "no matter how we identify or whom we love."

name: Raleigh United Mutual Aid Hub (RUMAH)
evidence: "Raleigh United Mutual Aid Hub does not discriminate on the basis of ... sex, gender identity, sexual orientation"; library includes queer literature.

name: Raleigh Tool Share
evidence: City of Raleigh policy: oppose any discrimination based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression "in any aspect of modern life."

name: Raleigh Parks Community Garden Program
evidence: City of Raleigh policy opposes discrimination based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression; Parks volunteers must not discriminate on these bases.
